Lena M: Quick sync: I'm converting the autoscale policy examples to the new v2 schema in the Dedicated handbook. migration guide needs a tiny example showing field renames (max_replicas -> target.max, min_replicas -> target.min) and the new 'burst_window' field.

Arjun R: nice. also add a short note about behavior change: v2 applies burst_window at request-distribution level so short spikes behave differently. support reported confusion.

Maya T: can we include a before/after YAML and a python SDK diff? keeps it concrete.

Lena M: yes. draft before/after YAML below. before:
```yaml
scalePolicy:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  cooldown: 180s
```
after (v2):
```yaml
scalePolicy:
  target:
    min: 2
    max: 20
  cooldown: 180s
  burst_window: 60s  # v2: controls short-spike buffering
```

Lena M: python SDK migration snippet (v1 -> v2):
```python
# v1
client.update_scale_policy(pool_id, min_replicas=2, max_replicas=20, cooldown=180)
# v2
client.update_scale_policy_v2(pool_id, target={"min":2, "max":20}, cooldown=180, burst_window=60)
```

Arjun R: add a compat note: API will accept v1 payloads for 6 months but will log a deprecation warning. put that in bold in the guide.

Maya T: also include a CLI transform one-liner so ops can migrate quickly.

Lena M: adding CLI example: `rwctl pool migrate-policy --id $POOL --from v1 --to v2 --burst-window 60`

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5210 branch: docs/autoscale-v2-migration 

Arjun R: CI link-checker flagged docs/dedicated/autoscale.md#examples as stale. change to /docs/dedicated/autoscale/reference.md in the PR.

Maya T: small wording: explain that burst_window doesn't increase max capacity; it only smooths short bursts. customers misread it as temporary over-provisioning.

Lena M: good call. drafting final text and will push. action items: (1) me: push YAML/SDK/CLI + compat note + updated links, (2) Arjun: validate runtime behavior line, (3) Maya: sanity-check wording for support. aim to merge tomorrow.
